slides.title: The mail pile isn't a character flaw. Here's the 2-minute system.
Open mail standing next to the recycling
slides.body: Not at the table. The recycling bin is the first stop. Most mail is junk and leaves in seconds.

slides.title: Only 3 piles allowed
slides.body: Pay. Do. File. That's it. Anything that doesn't fit is recycling.

slides.title: One folder for 'Pay' and 'Do'
slides.body: A bright colored folder by the door or the fridge. Bright so it doesn't blend into the counter.

slides.title: Pick a paper day
slides.body: Once a week, 10 minutes, same day. Clear the folder with a coffee. Put it on the calendar with an alarm.

slides.title: Stop it at the source
slides.body: Switch bills to paperless one at a time. Unsubscribe from one catalog each paper day.

slides.title: Mail is a surprise to-do list that arrives every day. Of course it piles up.
Make paper day easy
slides.body: The Tidy Brain Printable Pack has a paper day checklist and a bill tracker. Print and stick them by the folder. Link in bio.
